tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Amazon is in talks to buy artificial intelligence startup Decart for around US$7 billion, according to reporting from The Straits Times still open.
Nvidia and AMD are exploring acquisitions of artificial intelligence model companies to counter open-source models like DeepSeek, reported by 旺得富理財網.
OpenWork offers an open-source artificial intelligence automation option with model flexibility and local execution capability, reported by XDA Developers.
Trump launches Super Intelligence Force while China links artificial intelligence to national security amid growing strategic competition between the US and China, reported by ETtoday新聞雲.
Kentucky AG sues Character.AI over alleged suicide and exploitation risks in chatbot interactions, reported by WDRB.
Free every hour.
